clue.text: Is a young shaver so impudent?

definitions.text: Is a young shaver so impudent?

parts.words: Is a young shaver so impudent?
parts.note: a young shaver is a boy too young to grow a beard, so his face is literally without hair, a word that also means brazen or shameless

explanation.definitionFit: A brazen, shameless person shows open impudence without trying to hide it.

clue.text: Officer given support, with capacity to support bodyguard

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece placed below holds up what sits above it

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment
the SS was Hitler's bodyguard, the Schutzstaffel
a hat is a role or capacity, as in wearing another hat

explanation.surface: An officer is given backing, and the authority to back up his own bodyguard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capacity' as a role (wearing another hat) is the stretch; 'to support' places that piece beneath the bodyguard letters in the down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior army officer is informally called this, after the gold braid on the cap.

clue.text: Journey on horseback includes grand hilltop area

indicators.note: one piece takes in the other, so the journey word contains the grand letter

parts.note: a ride is a journey on horseback
G is short for grand, a thousand pounds

explanation.surface: A trot on horseback takes in an impressive stretch of high ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A long narrow raised strip of land along the top of hills is this feature.

clue.text: A rare film may produce cause for consternation

indicators.note: the letters of the fodder may be worked into something new, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: An unusual movie could provoke dismay.
explanation.definitionFit: A warning bell sounding a blaze is an obvious source of alarm and dismay.

clue.text: Argue about number entering 'diplomatic corps

indicators.note: the words for about and number go inside the corps abbreviation

parts.note: CD stands for Corps Diplomatique, the diplomatic corps
on means about or concerning
ten is a number

explanation.surface: A dispute over some figure reaching the diplomatic community.
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain or assert in argument is a common synonym.

clue.text: Unusual facet in party — recognising reality!

indicators.note: the rearranged letters sit inside the party word

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: unusual tells us the letters of facet appear in an altered order

explanation.surface: A strange side to a celebration, exclaimed as a moment of facing facts.
explanation.definitionFit: This Latin phrase means existing in fact rather than by right, so it acknowledges what actually is.

clue.text: Snapshot capturing a hooligan, finally losing control?

indicators.note: the photo word holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a pic is a photograph

indicators.note: finally picks out the last letter of hooligan

explanation.surface: A photograph catches a thug at the moment he finally loses it.
explanation.definitionFit: Sudden overwhelming fear makes a person lose self-command; the question mark marks the noun-for-state looseness.

clue.text: Quietly encourage to get rid of undesirable elements

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet
to urge is to encourage

explanation.surface: Softly spur someone on to clear out the unwanted.
explanation.definitionFit: Political cleansing removes opponents or impurities from an organisation.

clue.text: Pests cause inns to be abandoned

indicators.note: abandoned suggests wild, unrestrained, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Troublemakers force pubs to close.
explanation.definitionFit: Annoying people or things that bother everyone are pests.

clue.text: Swindle which is elusive to some extent

indicators.note: to some extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A con that is hard to pin down.
explanation.definitionFit: To cheat someone out of money is slang for swindle, as in chiselling a customer.

clue.text: Tree rather bare after first of blossom's gone

indicators.note: the letter named is gone, dropped from the comparative word

parts.note: balder means more bare, rather bare

indicators.note: first of picks the opening letter of blossom

explanation.surface: A tree loses its look once the first flowers have fallen.
explanation.definitionFit: A tree of the birch family, common by rivers.

clue.text: Old Queen appears fit in rite to be broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast seed is scattered, so the letters are scattered into a new order

parts.note: as printed these letters have one E too few and one I too many

explanation.surface: An ancient queen looks suitable for a ceremony to be televised.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed fodder cannot give the answer: it needs E where it shows the second I, so the setter's fodder should have been FIT IN TREE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Egyptian queen, wife of Akhenaten, is famous from her painted bust.

clue.text: Reference in manual to possible leak

definitions.meaning: the cross-reference instruction in a book, directing the reader to another leaf
a slow oozing of liquid through a crack or porous material

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it is a book's cross-reference; as one it is fluid escaping slowly.

clue.text: Make a fuss about begum finally being put on pyre

indicators.note: the fuss word goes around the other letter

parts.note: to create is to make a fuss

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of begum

explanation.surface: A protest over a Muslim lady at last being laid on a funeral fire.
explanation.definitionFit: To burn a corpse, as on a funeral pyre, is this.

clue.text: Call for ratings to be given urgent attention

definitions.text: Call for ratings to be given urgent attention

parts.words: Call for ratings to be given urgent attention
parts.note: ratings are ordinary sailors, and the naval order summons every one of them topside for an emergency

explanation.definitionFit: The shipboard emergency order summons every crew member; figuratively, everyone must help.

clue.text: Faultless, as a couple of noted boys are

definitions.text: as a couple of noted boys are
definitions.meaning: in the folk song Green Grow the Rushes, O, two are the boys clothed all in green-o, described with this phrase; noted means set to music

explanation.definitionFit: Spotless purity like a lily's petals means beyond reproach.

clue.text: Make dry and heated?

indicators.note: to make the answer the letters of the two words are worked together into a new order

explanation.surface: Drying something out by heating it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make' signals the anagram of DRY plus HEATED, and the whole clue also describes the process.
explanation.definitionFit: To remove moisture, often by warmth, is to desiccate.

clue.text: Not paying attention, forget duck in casserole cooking

indicators.note: cooking means the letters of casserole are stirred into a new order

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O

explanation.surface: An inattentive cook forgets the duck in the stew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forget' says the O must be left out: CASSEROLE without its O is shuffled into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Heedless, negligent behaviour shows inattention.

clue.text: Ancient Mariner reluctantly supported by Sinbad?

definitions.meaning: in the Arabian Nights the sailor is forced to carry a clinging creature on his shoulders

explanation.definitionFit: Literally an elderly seafarer; in the tale, the burden Sinbad cannot shake off.

clue.text: Denial partners united church without rivals?

parts.note: no is a denial
in bridge North and South are partners

explanation.surface: A refusal from a couple joined in church leaves them with no competitors.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaically, something unrivalled or matchless; a paragon.

clue.text: Spotted halves of fleece unpicked

indicators.note: halves of keeps only one half of each word: the front half of the first and the back half of the second, dropping ECE and UNPI

explanation.surface: Sections of a fleece that have not been sorted show marks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'halves of' drops the back half of FLEECE (ECE) and the front half of UNPICKED (UNPI), leaving FLE and CKED.
explanation.definitionFit: Marked with small patches or specks of colour.

clue.text: Supercilious and totally heartless specimen, somewhat suspect

indicators.note: totally heartless removes the whole interior, leaving only the first and last letters

parts.note: iffy means doubtful, somewhat suspect

explanation.surface: A haughty, utterly cold character who seems a bit dodgy.
explanation.definitionFit: Disdainful, looking down one's nose, is a near-synonym of haughty.

clue.text: Women troubled about fate of declining crescent

indicators.note: troubled stirs up the letters of women

parts.note: on means about

explanation.surface: Women worried over what happens to a waning sliver.
explanation.definitionFit: A waning crescent moon dwindles until the lunar phase with no visible disc.

clue.text: Prepped for a row, starting over another really expensive dress

indicators.note: starting means the first letter of each following word is taken

explanation.surface: Dressed up for a quarrel, beginning again with another pricey frock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' looks like a quarrel but is the boating sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Fitted with paddles, ready for rowing.

clue.text: So far, looking forward to finding a mate?

definitions.text: So far, looking forward to finding a mate?

parts.words: So far, looking forward to finding a mate?
parts.note: read as a lonely-hearts line, but it describes the last stage of a chess game, where players look for checkmate

explanation.definitionFit: The final phase of a chess game, when checkmate is in sight.

clue.text: One of six kings in earlier trouble

indicators.note: the king letters go inside the earlier word

parts.note: ago means earlier, in the past
GR is George Rex; Britain has had six King Georges

explanation.surface: A monarch among half a dozen caused strife back then.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for aggressive trouble or hassle.

clue.text: Heard someone cooking food did he enjoy it alfresco?

indicators.note: heard says the word for a cook sounds like the holy man

parts.note: a fryer is someone who fries food
tuck is British slang for food, especially schoolchildren's snacks

explanation.surface: A cook overheard asking whether someone liked eating outdoors.
explanation.walkthrough: The outlaw's chaplain of Robin Hood legend feasted in Sherwood Forest, hence dining in the open air.
explanation.definitionFit: The jovial friar of Robin Hood's band famously feasted in the greenwood.

clue.text: One passing ninety shows obtuseness

parts.note: read as an elderly person getting dull, but in geometry anything above ninety degrees is called obtuse

explanation.definitionFit: A figure formed by two lines meeting is obtuse when it exceeds a right one.

clue.text: Respond when forced to return

definitions.meaning: a return or output, as of a crop or investment

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: give way under pressure, and the output produced by an investment.

clue.text: They usually turn round when threatened

definitions.text: They usually turn round when threatened

parts.words: They usually turn round when threatened
parts.note: read as people turning to face danger, but these spiny animals curl into a ball

explanation.definitionFit: Spiny garden mammals roll into a protective ball at danger.
